# qualys_was_auth_records (Data Source)

Look up Qualys WAS authentication records, for associating a web
application (`qualys_was_application`'s `auth_record_ids`) or a scan
schedule (`qualys_was_scan_schedule`'s `web_app_auth_record_id`) with a
record managed outside Terraform, by name instead of a hardcoded ID.
Credential contents are never exposed here — Qualys masks them, the same
way the resource's own Read does.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_was_auth_records" "staging" {
  name_contains = "Staging"
}

output "staging_auth_record_id" {
  value = one([for r in data.qualys_was_auth_records.staging.auth_records : r.id])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **name_contains** (String) Filter results to records whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive). Applied client-side, after the API call.

### Read-Only

- **auth_records** (List of Object) Matching authentication records, ordered by ID for stable output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth_records))

<a id="nestedatt--auth_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth_records`

Read-Only:

- **comments** (String)
- **created** (String)
- **id** (String)
- **name** (String)
- **tag_ids** (List of String)
